registryTitle: Miraverse Phoenician Archaeological and Historical Source Registry

verifiedSources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Byblos (Site #295)
verifiedSources.citation: UNESCO (1984), World Heritage List: Byblos, Lebanon. Criteria (iii), (iv), (vi).
verifiedSources.relevance: Temple of the Obelisks, L-Shaped Temple, Royal Necropolis, and Bronze Age harbour.

verifiedSources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Tyre (Site #299)
verifiedSources.citation: UNESCO (1984), World Heritage List: Tyre, Lebanon. Criteria (iii), (vi).
verifiedSources.relevance: Phoenician island acropolis, submerged twin breakwaters, Sidonian and Egyptian harbours.

verifiedSources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Archaeological Site of Carthage (Site #37)
verifiedSources.citation: UNESCO (1979), World Heritage List: Archaeological Site of Carthage, Tunisia. Criteria (ii), (iii), (vi).
verifiedSources.relevance: Byrsa acropolis, Magon residential quarter, Opus Africanum architecture, Punic Cothon.

verifiedSources.title: Fouilles de Byblos (1926–1938, 1939–1958)
verifiedSources.author: Maurice Dunand
verifiedSources.citation: Dunand, M. (1939, 1954, 1958). Fouilles de Byblos, Volumes I & II. Librairie Orientaliste Paul Geuthner, Paris.
verifiedSources.relevance: Excavation records of Temple of the Obelisks, numbering of 26 limestone obelisks, and relocation above the L-Shaped Temple.

verifiedSources.title: Byblos et l'Égypte: Quatre Campagnes de Fouilles à Gebeil
verifiedSources.author: Pierre Montet
verifiedSources.citation: Montet, P. (1928). Byblos et l'Égypte: Quatre Campagnes de Fouilles à Gebeil 1921-1922-1923-1924. Paris.
verifiedSources.relevance: Discovery and photographic documentation of Royal Tomb V, Ahiram Sarcophagus and linear Phoenician inscription.

verifiedSources.title: Holocene Coastal Dynamics and Geoarchaeology of Tyre Harbours
verifiedSources.author: Nick Marriner, Christophe Morhange, Michel Boudagher-Fadel
verifiedSources.citation: Marriner, N., Morhange, C., & Boudagher-Fadel, M. (2007). Geoarchaeology of Tyre's ancient harbours, Phoenicia. Journal of Archaeological Science, 35(5), 1281-1310.
verifiedSources.relevance: Subsurface cores and sonar evidence for island isolation prior to Alexander's 332 BCE mole and subsequent tombolo formation.

verifiedSources.title: The Punic Ship: Final Excavation Report
verifiedSources.author: Honor Frost et al.
verifiedSources.citation: Frost, H. et al. (1981). Notizie degli Scavi di Antichità, Serie VIII, Vol. XXX. Accademia Nazionale dei Lincei, Rome.
verifiedSources.relevance: Punic warship hull construction, mortise-and-tenon joints, Phoenician dunnage letters, ship ram morphology.

verifiedSources.title: Mozia: Scavi e Ricerche Archeologiche
verifiedSources.author: Vincenzo Tusa & Sebastiano Tusa
verifiedSources.citation: Tusa, V. (1978). La Civiltà Punica in Italia: Mozia. Accademia Nazionale dei Lincei.
verifiedSources.relevance: Island topography, submerged causeway to Birgi, rectangular Kothon basin, North Gate battlements.

verifiedSources.title: Mission de Phénicie
verifiedSources.author: Ernest Renan
verifiedSources.citation: Renan, E. (1864). Mission de Phénicie. Imprimerie Impériale, Paris.
verifiedSources.relevance: Epigraphy and initial surveys of Temple of Eshmun at Bostan esh-Sheikh and Sidon coastal necropolises.

verifiedSources.title: The Punic Ports at Carthage
verifiedSources.author: Lawrence E. Stager & Henry Hurst
verifiedSources.citation: Hurst, H. (1994). Excavations at Carthage: The British Mission, Vol. II, 1: The Circular Harbour (Cothon). Oxford University Press.
verifiedSources.relevance: Circular military harbor, dry docks for 220 vessels, central island admiral pavilion, rectangular commercial port.
